note: The same tree with all four excluded roots removed. Its digest is IDENTICAL to `tree-golden.json` — that equality is the whole content of 'excludes .git/, secrets/, transcripts/, operator-requests/'. It is also the reason the digest cannot be the control against smuggled bytes (see `smuggled-git-hooks.json`): the profile is blind here by design. Unlike the golden tree, this one carries no excluded root, so it IS materializable.
